proof: the AI Workforce HTTP boundary, exercised against a RUNNING next start server with real signed session cookies, on a throwaway database inside the isolated development cluster

assertions.title: STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server refuses an unauthenticated request with 401, and says nothing else
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server refuses a signed-in user with no workforce access (403), before any lifecycle work
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server issues a Command over HTTP, and reports the durable mission it created
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server returns the SAME mission for an idempotent retry, and creates no second execution
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server refuses a reused idempotency key carrying a DIFFERENT command (409)
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server rejects malformed input without touching the lifecycle
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server reads a mission, settles it over HTTP, and completes it with a human decision
STEP 5 — the AI Workforce HTTP routes, against a running server never leaks a database URL, a bridge endpoint or a secret in an error body

environment.server: next start on 127.0.0.1, built from this tree
environment.database: the throwaway 'nexup_http_proof' database inside the isolated development cluster (127.0.0.1)
environment.productionDatabase: NOT touched: DATABASE_URL was pointed at the development cluster too, so not even the legacy pool could reach Supabase
environment.runtime: the deterministic TEST transport, which the application only honours for a verified loopback database
environment.auth: a fixed, obviously-fake AUTH_SECRET used only to sign this proof's own cookies

howToReproduce: node scripts/dev-db.mjs up        # the isolated loopback cluster
